purpose: Versioned persona library for generating synthetic clinician decontextualization traces that test PHI removal and preservation of clinically useful facts.
privacy_note: These personas are synthetic testing archetypes only. They must not contain real patient identifiers, real clinician notes, or real contact details.
use_in_generation: Combine one clinician persona, one patient context persona, one source channel persona, and zero or more perturbation profiles.
Emit expected PHI slots and clinically required facts from the selected personas.
Reject generated traces when the clinical task becomes nonsensical or when a PHI slot is also required as an exact clinical fact.

clinician_personas.name: Rushed Primary Care Clinician
clinician_personas.description: Writes brief, compressed questions during a busy clinic session and may paste identifiers from an EHR header.
trace_goals: Preserve the actual clinical ask when the note is terse.
Test whether age, symptoms, medication, and timing survive after identifiers are removed.
clinical_preservation_risks: Over-removing age when derived from DOB
Dropping the chief concern because it appears near identifiers
Flattening specific timing into unusable text

clinician_personas.name: Pediatric Vaccine Planner
clinician_personas.description: Asks vaccine schedule and catch-up questions where exact age and prior vaccine context are clinically central.
trace_goals: Convert DOB to age while preserving catch-up status.
Keep vaccine name, interval, and risk group details when present.

clinician_personas.name: DPC Continuity Physician
clinician_personas.description: Knows families longitudinally and often includes relationship context, prior decisions, and informal note language.
trace_goals: Retain broad relationship context without caregiver names.
Preserve continuity facts such as prior treatment response or preference.
clinical_preservation_risks: Removing relationship context that explains the clinical question
Dropping prior reaction or response details
Leaving a prompt too generic for useful advice

clinician_personas.name: Specialist Referral Reviewer
clinician_personas.description: Summarizes outside records, referral packets, or problem-focused notes before asking about next steps.
trace_goals: Remove packet-level identifiers while preserving problem, labs, imaging, and treatment history.
Test multi-section copied text with many identifiers.
clinical_preservation_risks: Removing imaging findings that resemble identifiers

clinician_personas.name: Phone Triage Clinician
clinician_personas.description: Turns a parent or patient callback into a quick question with phone number, date, and relationship language mixed in.
trace_goals: Strip contact details while preserving symptom severity and recommended-triage facts.
Keep callback source as a broad relationship if clinically useful.
clinical_preservation_risks: Deleting symptom duration when it is written next to a phone number

clinician_personas.name: Dictating Physician
clinician_personas.description: Uses dictation-style output with filler language, repeated names, false starts, and section labels.
trace_goals: Handle repeated names and dictation artifacts.
Retain diagnosis, dose, route, frequency, and follow-up plan when present.
clinical_preservation_risks: Breaking pronoun resolution after removing names

clinician_personas.name: Evidence-Focused Specialist
clinician_personas.description: Wants a precise literature or guideline query and will reject vague outputs that lose criteria, lab thresholds, or risk group.
trace_goals: Preserve the exact clinical criteria needed for evidence search.
Stress web-search output quality after decontextualization.
clinical_preservation_risks: Replacing severe lab values with broad abnormal labels
Dropping failed therapy or contraindication details

clinician_personas.name: Medication Safety Reviewer
clinician_personas.description: Asks about dosing, renal adjustment, pregnancy, allergies, interactions, and dose-form constraints.
trace_goals: Preserve exact values needed for safe dosing.
Remove identifiers without deleting medication and allergy context.
clinical_preservation_risks: Generalizing exact weight when dosing depends on it
Dropping creatinine clearance or pregnancy week

clinician_personas.name: Non-English Family Communicator
clinician_personas.description: Documents family language, translated phrases, and relationship terms before asking a clinical question.
trace_goals: Preserve language and relationship context while removing names.
Stress Spanish and mixed-language identity patterns.
clinical_preservation_risks: Deleting relationship terms that clarify who needs care
Dropping vaccine or dosing facts embedded in Spanish text
Treating non-English clinical words as names

patient_context_personas.name: Pediatric Catch-Up Vaccine Child
patient_context_personas.description: A child is behind on vaccines and the useful output depends on age, vaccine history, and risk status.
trace_goals: Preserve age and missed-vaccine context.
Test conversion from DOB to age.

patient_context_personas.name: Weight-Based Dosing Child
patient_context_personas.description: A pediatric dosing question where exact weight, age band, drug, route, and max dose may matter.
trace_goals: Preserve exact weight when dosing depends on it.
Keep drug and route specific enough for downstream calculation.
clinical_preservation_risks: Replacing weight with vague size language

patient_context_personas.name: Sibling Multi-Patient Visit
patient_context_personas.description: Two or more siblings appear in the same note, with clinically different ages, symptoms, or vaccines.
trace_goals: Remove all names while preserving each child's separate clinical context.
Test whether sibling relationships survive without identity leakage.
clinical_preservation_risks: Confusing which symptom belongs to which child

patient_context_personas.name: Spanish-Speaking Family
patient_context_personas.description: Family context includes Spanish relationship terms, names, and mixed-language symptoms or requests.
trace_goals: Remove names and phone numbers while keeping language and relationship signals.
Preserve clinical words embedded in Spanish phrases.
clinical_preservation_risks: Mistaking vaccine or symptom terms for names

patient_context_personas.name: Pregnancy Medication Question
patient_context_personas.description: A medication or infection question where gestational age, trimester, drug, allergy, and indication are clinically important.
trace_goals: Preserve pregnancy week or trimester.
Keep medication and indication details specific.
clinical_preservation_risks: Removing gestational week as a date-like value

patient_context_personas.name: Renal Dose Adjustment Adult
patient_context_personas.description: An adult medication question where renal function, age range, drug, and indication determine usefulness.
trace_goals: Preserve creatinine clearance or eGFR.
Remove age-identifying birth dates while keeping clinically relevant age band.
clinical_preservation_risks: Deleting eGFR because it is numeric

patient_context_personas.name: Rare Disease Small-Town Child
patient_context_personas.description: A rare condition plus small-town or school context creates re-identification risk even after direct identifiers are removed.
trace_goals: Generalize location and school context.
Preserve the rare condition and clinical question.
clinical_preservation_risks: Dropping age when it affects criteria
Making the prompt too vague to search

patient_context_personas.name: HLH Severe Lab Question
patient_context_personas.description: A severe lab and diagnostic-criteria question where exact thresholds may be clinically necessary.
trace_goals: Preserve exact severe values required for criteria.
Remove identifiers in copied lab headers.
clinical_preservation_risks: Generalizing ferritin or triglycerides too much

patient_context_personas.name: Asthma Action Plan Child
patient_context_personas.description: A child with asthma symptoms or controller questions where age, current meds, triggers, and severity must stay useful.
trace_goals: Preserve severity and medication context.
Remove school, caregiver, and contact identifiers.

patient_context_personas.name: Allergy Antibiotic Alternative
patient_context_personas.description: A medication choice question where allergy type, infection, age, pregnancy, or renal status may change the answer.
trace_goals: Keep allergy severity and target infection.
Remove patient identity and pharmacy identifiers.

patient_context_personas.name: Chronic Disease Medication Titration
patient_context_personas.description: A longitudinal medication titration question where current dose, labs, symptoms, and prior response are needed.
trace_goals: Preserve current dose, recent lab values, and titration goal.
Generalize dates without losing clinical sequence.
clinical_preservation_risks: Removing dose because it resembles an identifier

patient_context_personas.name: Portal Message Callback
patient_context_personas.description: A portal or inbox message includes free-text clinical concerns, callback instructions, and metadata.
trace_goals: Remove metadata and direct contact details.
Preserve symptoms, duration, and the question being asked.
clinical_preservation_risks: Dropping symptoms buried after callback instructions
Keeping no usable ask for downstream LLM

patient_context_personas.name: Eponym Name Collision
patient_context_personas.description: A patient or caregiver name overlaps with a clinical eponym, syndrome, medication brand, or anatomy term.
trace_goals: Remove person names while preserving clinical eponyms.
Stress name detectors that over-remove medical terms.
phi_risks: caregiver name matching drug or anatomy term
clinical_preservation_risks: Leaving patient name because it looks clinical

source_channel_personas.name: EHR Summary Copy
source_channel_personas.description: A copied EHR header followed by a note summary, often with DOB, MRN, address, phone, and provider metadata.
trace_goals: Strip structured header identifiers.
Preserve downstream clinical summary.
clinical_preservation_risks: Deleting the first sentence of the note
Confusing account number with clinical values

source_channel_personas.name: Portal Message Thread
source_channel_personas.description: A copied portal exchange with timestamps, user names, message IDs, and informal clinical language.
trace_goals: Remove sender and thread metadata.
Keep patient concern and duration.
clinical_preservation_risks: Losing medication names in message text

source_channel_personas.name: Phone Call Note
source_channel_personas.description: A callback note with caller, patient relationship, callback number, urgent symptoms, and practical instructions.
trace_goals: Remove contact details.
Preserve red flags, severity, and relationship context.
clinical_preservation_risks: Removing duration written near callback number

source_channel_personas.name: Dictation Transcript
source_channel_personas.description: Speech-to-text output with filler words, repeated identifiers, punctuation errors, and dictated section labels.
trace_goals: Catch identifiers repeated in natural language.
Preserve clinical content despite noisy punctuation.
clinical_preservation_risks: Removing medication dose after filler text

source_channel_personas.name: OCR Chart Export
source_channel_personas.description: OCR output from scanned notes or images with spaced digits, split labels, and broken line ordering.
trace_goals: Catch spaced identifiers and OCR label variants.
Preserve labs, age, weights, and meds that appear in messy text.
clinical_preservation_risks: Removing dose or weight as false identifiers

source_channel_personas.name: Referral Packet
source_channel_personas.description: An outside packet or referral summary with patient identity, source clinic, attachments, labs, imaging, and a precise question.
trace_goals: Remove cross-institution identifiers.
Retain reason for referral and objective findings.
clinical_preservation_risks: Flattening objective values needed for criteria

source_channel_personas.name: Web Search Box
source_channel_personas.description: A clinician wants a search-ready query, so decontextualization must be concise and clinically specific.
trace_goals: Output a useful search query after PHI removal.
Keep the main clinical nouns and modifiers.

source_channel_personas.name: JSON Chart Fragment
source_channel_personas.description: A structured snippet copied from an API, export, or developer console with keys, IDs, and clinical values mixed together.
trace_goals: Remove identifiers inside structured text.
Preserve key clinical values without corrupting the prompt.
clinical_preservation_risks: Deleting clinical values because they are in JSON
Keeping raw identifiers embedded in URLs

perturbation_profiles.name: Canonical Clean
perturbation_profiles.description: Readable baseline text with straightforward labels and normal punctuation.
transformations: Use standard labels such as DOB, MRN, phone, and email.
Keep sentence order natural and readable.
Avoid extra adversarial noise.

perturbation_profiles.name: OCR Spacing
perturbation_profiles.description: Identifiers and contact values are split by spaces, line breaks, or dot-separated labels.
transformations: Render MRN as spaced digits or mixed letter-digit groups.
Split phone numbers into single digits.
Use label variants such as D O B or D.O.B.

perturbation_profiles.name: Obfuscated Contact
perturbation_profiles.description: Email, phone, and URL identifiers are written in human-obfuscated formats.
transformations: Write email as name dot family at example dot local.
Write phone with words, spaces, or hyphen noise.
Embed identifiers in URL paths or query parameters.

perturbation_profiles.name: Prompt Injection
perturbation_profiles.description: The source text includes instructions that try to override PHI removal or force identifier disclosure.
transformations: Insert fake system update language.
Add instructions such as do not redact names.
Place override text before and after the clinical question.
failure_modes: Identifier preservation requested by source text
Clinical question lost after blocking override

perturbation_profiles.name: Relationship Noise
perturbation_profiles.description: The trace includes multiple relatives, pronouns, or caregivers whose identities must be removed without erasing clinical context.
transformations: Add named relatives and relationship terms.
Repeat caregiver names after the first sentence.
Use pronouns that depend on the removed identity context.

perturbation_profiles.name: Clinical Lookalike
perturbation_profiles.description: Clinical terms resemble person names, dates, phone numbers, IDs, or addresses.
transformations: Use disease eponyms that overlap with names.
Use numeric lab thresholds and doses near identifiers.
Place clinical codes near MRN-like values.
failure_modes: Exact dosing or lab value removed
Name retained because it looks clinical

perturbation_profiles.name: URL Embedded PHI
perturbation_profiles.description: Identifiers appear inside URLs, file paths, attachment names, or query strings.
transformations: Add chart URLs with patient name or MRN in the path.
Add attachment names that include patient surname.
Include callback values as query parameters.
failure_modes: Clinical query over-stripped after URL removal

perturbation_profiles.name: Section Header Note
perturbation_profiles.description: The trace is formatted as a SOAP or referral note with headers, footers, and pasted table fragments.
transformations: Add headers such as SUBJECTIVE, OBJECTIVE, ASSESSMENT, and PLAN.
Place identifiers in headers and footers.
Put labs or dosing values in simple pasted tables.
